decisive_items: On T2-weighted fat-suppressed images, they were homogeneously hyperintense without cystic degeneration; each was surrounded by a hyperintense rim.
A small extension of high signal from the lateral aspect of one lesion resembled a “mouse-tail.”
response.rationale: R2 directly matches focal diagnosis and imaging hallmarks; R1 has pain features but lacks imaging support; R3 contradicted by absent NF history and less typical imaging.

rejected.why: Imaging pattern not supportive; lesions are along nerves, not vascular tumor features.
No NF history and imaging more consistent with schwannoma than neurofibroma.
